frontier.hypothesis: There is an insn shape that survives cse1 AND flow but is deleted by COMBINE (not by cse1), which can be repeated ~5 times in the loop-top block ahead of `var_t2 = 0` without adding weighted references to any already-seated variable - lifting L73 from 23 to 28 at zero emitted-byte cost and closing the frame-bearing chassis outright.
frontier.mechanism: s9 proved the only insn-deleting pass AFTER flow's ref/liveness scan is combine, so a flow-visible-but-unemitted insn must be one combine MERGES INTO its consumer rather than one cse1 makes dead. On MIPS the merges combine actually performs in this function are (a) `(plus reg const)` folded into a `mem` address and (b) the QI-load + zero_extend pair folded into a single `lbu` - the second already supplies two free insns inside the inner loop, which is direct proof the shape exists in this function's own logic.
